candidates.new:
TAX
    JSR ground_square               \ layer 4: multiply_A_by_X_2f1e's A x X from a table (HAZEL); leaves A = X * X (its LDA squares,X; nothing after it touches A)
    CLC                             \ layer 5: for the ADC, and the C = 0 edge_left_loop takes on entry
    LDY column_buffer + 9           \ step 2 (grind): Y, not A, so A = t * t stays; Y is dead (the callers load it next)
    BNE leave_1c4e                  \ Don't add ground if a bridge is present
    ADC #LO(ground_columns)         \ step 2 (grind): the loads' base patched into the loop (below), t * t + ground_columns
    STA ground_load_a + 1           \ (one page, ASSERTed after the table; C = 0 out, no carry)
    STA ground_load_b + 1
    LDY #&13
    LDA column_buffer + 21
    BNE add_ground_to_column_buffer_loop    \ Don't add ground edge if runway present
    LDA ground_edge_bottom_pixel_values,X
    STA column_buffer + 22
    LDA column_buffer + 23
    AND ground_edge_masks,X
    EOR ground_edge_top_pixel_values,X
    STA column_buffer + 23
    LDY #&15
.add_ground_to_column_buffer_loop   \ step 2 (grind): two rows a turn, Y odd at the top (&15 or &13); Layer 5 (BUGS #1 fixed): the type's rows from a fixed texture (ground_columns + t * t + Y)
.ground_load_a
    LDA ground_columns,Y            \ operand low byte patched above
    STA column_buffer,Y             \ Add ground to column buffe
    DEY
.ground_load_b
    LDA ground_columns,Y            \ operand low byte patched above
    STA column_buffer,Y
    DEY
    BPL add_ground_to_column_buffer_loop
.leave_1c4e
    RTS
IF GAMEPLAY_ANY = 0
    SKIP 1                          \ step 2 (grind): never run; keeps the padding after it where it was
ENDIF
ASSERT LO(ground_columns) + 9 + 21 < &100, "ground_columns + t * t + Y stays in its page"
candidates.summary: add_ground_to_column_buffer: drop the dead PHA/PLA/TAX (ground_square keeps X, A is overwritten next), and patch t*t+ground_columns into the two loads' operand low bytes so the 22-row copy runs on Y alone: no DEX pair, 25 cycles per two rows instead of 29. Uses A = t*t as ground_square leaves it (LDY, not LDA, for the bridge test keeps A). Candidates 2 and 3 are alternatives (same loop idea; they read result_low and cost 3 more cycles an execution, or less gain).
candidates.equivalence: Row r (0..21, or 0..19 with a runway) of column_buffer receives ground_columns[t*t + r] exactly as before: the old X started at t*t + Y (TYA; ADC result_low with C=0) and fell by 1 with Y; now the two loads' operand is ground_columns + t*t, indexed by Y itself, so the same byte. Rows are written in the same order (Y, Y-1, ...) and the loop still ends with Y = &FF after the second DEY (Y odd at the top, &13 or &15, as before). The patch (A = LO(ground_columns) + t*t, at most &53 + 9, no carry) runs only on the non-bridge path, before the runway test; the bridge path leaves with C = 0 (CLC) and the same memory as before. A = t*t at the ADC: ground_square's last write to A is LDA squares,X (its CPX, BCC, CLV, STZs and RTS leave A), and CLC and LDY do not touch it. Exits: X is now t (was the loop's leftover X, or t on the bridge path), Y is column_buffer+9 on the bridge path (was the caller's), A is not what it was: all dead, since both callers (layers_left_done, layers_right_done) reload X and Y in use_viewport_*_as_edge before any read and reload or ignore A. C = 0 on every exit, as edge_left_loop needs it (an ADC with C = 0 cannot carry here). V: ground_square's on the bridge path as before; the ADC leaves it 0 on the other (no signed overflow), as the old ADC did. The old PHA/PLA/TAX only restored A and X: ground_square keeps X, and A is overwritten by the next load. ground_rows is gone; the runway BNE goes straight to the loop label.
candidates.relies_on: ground_square (src/scroll_hazel.6502) leaving A = squares,X = t*t: true of its code today (its comment does not promise A, so a later change to it must keep it; the gate's state comparison would show a break). Self-modified operands ground_load_a + 1 and ground_load_b + 1 (&186F, &1876) are written before each use in the same call, in main RAM code. ground_columns' low byte (&53) + 30 stays in its page (ASSERT added), so the loads never cross a page, as before. Layout: the window is 62 bytes against 63; a SKIP 1 inside IF GAMEPLAY_ANY = 0 keeps the existing SKIP 3 and ground_left_x_low (&1883) where they were, so no table or code after it moves (in gameplay builds, which have no padding, what follows shifts down 1 byte, as it did when that padding was dropped). The loop is at &186E-&187D, one page, BPL back 3 cycles, no page crossing moved. Measured on a scratch copy of the unshifted DEBUG_LIVES build: passlock 3000 passes seed 1 --screen identical (state and screen); pcprof 1500 passes seed 1: window 99.79 -> 86.93 cycles a pass, logic 9440 -> 9427.
